usage: The word '熱奶茶' (jit6 naai5 caa4) is a noun used to refer to hot milk tea, a popular drink in Hong Kong.
You can use '熱奶茶' to order a drink at a restaurant or tea shop.
'熱奶茶' can be used as a subject or object in a sentence, for Example:  '我想飲熱奶茶' (I want to drink hot milk tea).
It is common to add adjectives or quantify '熱奶茶,' such as '一杯熱奶茶' (a cup of hot milk tea) or '好味嘅熱奶茶' (delicious hot milk tea).
'熱奶茶' can be contrasted with other drinks like '凍奶茶' (cold milk tea) to specify temperature preference.
